targeting.summary: Split Out expands a collection inside each item; it is not the same as batching existing items with Loop Over Items|Selected parent fields and an explicit destination preserve useful identifiers and make the output shape predictable|Multiple arrays align by position, empty arrays emit no children, serialized JSON needs parsing, and binary splitting retains attachment field names

primarySourceNotes: Node 1.1 supports explicit destination paths with dot notation; node 1 uses literal destination keys.
Single object arrays with No Other Fields and no destination are promoted into output JSON; other modes preserve a named split field.
Multiple fields align by element index and use the longest selected sequence; missing tails are omitted rather than replaced with fake values.
Absent fields become empty arrays; null and strings are wrapped as single values; plain objects use Object.values.
The real execute method was exercised with a mocked field-list parser and hint tracker, not a running n8n workflow. Hint behavior was separately read in SplitOut/utils.ts.
Aggregate documentation was checked to distinguish collection from array expansion.
